announcements.headline: EQS-News: Zalando grows profitably in Q3, driven by very strong B2B expansion, and continues innovating through AI with Zalando Extended
announcements.insight: Zalando reports Q3 profit growth driven by B2B expansion and AI innovation. This follows a similar profitable growth update in Q2.

announcements.headline: Original-Research: Zalando SE (von Quirin Privatbank Kapitalmarktgeschäft): Buy
announcements.insight: Zalando SE receives a buy recommendation from von Quirin Privatbank Kapitalmarktgeschäft. This follows Q2 profitable growth reported in August.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Zalando delivers another quarter of profitable growth in Q2, accelerates B2B expansion and continues innovating through AI
